title: fix(ci): scope the Axios preservation boundary test to changes that edit the preservation
intent: After PR #483 merged, Boundary.test_production_client_router_and_inventory_are_unchanged diffed every PR against origin/main and allow-listed only #483's own paths, so every later PR failed API Tests (first hit: PR #484 on .cbsp21/patches/tonewood-verification-001.json). Keep the guard for changes that edit the preservation; skip it with a stated reason otherwise.
behavior_change: CI only. The boundary test applies only when the change set touches a preservation-owned path. No production code, client, route, dependency or archive byte changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) Boundary now diffs against the merge-base (not the working tree vs origin/main), returns out-of-scope when no OWNED_PREFIXES path is touched, allows any .cbsp21/patches/ per-PR manifest, and checks package.json, package-lock.json, router/index.ts and the inventory CSV by name in the change set instead of comparing raw bytes to origin/main (raw bytes failed under Windows autocrlf). Two fixture tests pin both directions. (2) this manifest.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without it API Tests is red for every PR that is not #483, including Dependabot bumps of packages/client/package.json.

commands_run: throwaway worktree: this fix merged with origin/docs/tonewood-verification-001 -> boundary test SKIPPED (out of scope), suite green

files.intent: Scope the boundary test to preservation-editing change sets; pin both directions with fixtures.
